scheme_name: Grant of 50% Subsidy for the Purchase of Aquarium and Its Accessories under "Development of Freshwater Aquaculture and Setting up of Aquarium, Ornamental Fish Breeding Centre"
other_conditions: Applicant must possess a pucca house or commercial place to keep an aquarium
Applicant or any family member must not have previously benefited under the scheme
benefits_summary: A 50% subsidy of up to ₹3,500 is provided for an aquarium package (unit cost ₹7,000).
